verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes implementation-relevant rules that control-field labels be unique and not duplicate the existing field content.
The client requires label coverage for every interactive field and identifies the sample's fourth step as the concrete label-design reference; the testing request is not encoded in the Event.

The client changes the rendered label rule to match each field's initial instruction and requires hover help to preserve that instruction after replacement; updating the existing relation key leaves no stale conflicting attribute.
The client explicitly requires the guidance text to be rendered in both the control label and the field.
The client requires the field-purpose help to remain accessible after the field content is emptied.
The client requires visible in-field guidance instead of a blank field and permits the same guidance to appear in both the field and its label.
